summary.text: Micah Pookela Kim Aiu is the Democratic candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election, seeking to return to a seat he held from 2022 to 2024.
A lawyer, he faces Republican incumbent Garner Shimizu, who defeated him in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Micah Pookela Kim Aiu earned a J.D. from the University of Hawaii at Manoa in 2016.
His career experience includes working as in-house counsel with Nan, Inc., and as a litigation associate with Ashford & Wriston, LLP.
Aiu represented District 32 in the Hawaii House of Representatives from November 8, 2022, to November 5, 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Finance, Housing (as vice chair) and Transportation committees.
Garner Shimizu defeated Aiu in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Aiu advanced from the Democratic primary on August 8, 2026, and faces Shimizu again in the general election.
